name: FieldCheckbox
description: A checkbox. With @label it renders the awesome-bootstrap checkbox with a label that toggles it; without, the bare input.

label.description: Renders the labelled awesome-bootstrap checkbox (checkbox checkbox-primary form-checkbox), crimson when checked, with or without a .form-field ancestor

size.description: "sm" gives a 14px box and label line height, matching the list checkboxes, for toolbars and menus

data-select.description: Test anchor set on the input
